in_marathi.name: संदीप
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of Knowledge or Wisdom
in_marathi.long_meaning: संदीप हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name संदीप is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘सं’ (meaning ‘completely’) and ‘दीप’ (meaning ‘light’ or ‘knowledge’). It symbolizes the one who illuminates the path with the light of knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is referred to as ‘संदीपनाथ’, the lord of those who illuminate the path.

in_bengali.name: संदीप
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Light of Knowledge or Wisdom
in_bengali.long_meaning: संदीप একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name संदीप is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘सं’ (meaning ‘completely’) and ‘दीप’ (meaning ‘light’ or ‘knowledge’). It symbolizes the one who illuminates the path with the light of knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is referred to as ‘संदीपनाथ’, the lord of those who illuminate the path.
